summary: refactor(auth): move geo-data and promise-extras from fxa-shared
description:
Because:

- Only fxa-auth-server uses formatGeoData and props from fxa-shared.

This commit:

- Moves formatGeoData into auth-server lib/routes/utils/passwordless.ts.
- Moves promise-extras.ts into auth-server lib/ and adds the MPL header.
- Updates the passwordless route import and the reminders requires.
- Deletes fxa-shared lib/geo-data.ts.
- Adds specs for formatGeoData and props.

Closes FXA-14703
